decision: ENDORSE NO-GO for current source-dependent whole-region overlay/beta stage. Whole functional-region definition, applicable qualified shared assay and useful native EMC contrast remain pending. No material blocker in this focused review scope.
scope: Independent physical-region/methylation-method and scientific-value challenge before numerical stage. Prior four exact-primer-envelope review reused without rerunning mapping/probe counts. No fresh array overlay, beta matrix, EMC phenotype values, new raw downloads or image/UI work.

primary_source_checks.finding: Physical source definition explicitly labels IG-DMR as CG4 and CG6, versus MEG3-DMR CG7. Selected methylation methods use CpG-free primers and bisulfite restriction/sequencing. Source component assays do not authenticate a complete assembly-bound whole functional region for this contract. A future source could define multiple elements rather than one contiguous interval; it must not be replaced by an invented outer envelope.
primary_source_checks.restriction_scope: Human regulatory component definition and methylation-method section only. Patient structural-mechanism results and genomic alterations are not independently evaluated or used. Source-author functional hierarchy is prior-art context, not a newly verified mechanism or EMC finding.

primary_source_checks.finding: Methylation methods independently distinguish IG pyrosequencing/bisulfite CpGs and secondary MEG3 measurements. Authors explicitly state the 450K imprinting panel includes MEG3:TSS but not MEG3/DLK1:IG-DMR. This is contrary evidence about that assay/panel, not proof of no probes in every possible whole functional IG definition. Leukocyte/placental assays and reference thresholds do not supply native EMC values or normal tumor controls.

Selected bisulfite methods print a909bp/31CpG IG assay and an819bp/44CpG MEG3 assay tied to NT_026437.12 sequence positions. These are assayed fragments, not a source-validated complete functional CGI boundary or automatically a chromosome coordinate. Printed endpoint convention cannot be guessed from fragment length. No contig offset, primer-envelope union or human/mouse substitution is accepted.
primary_source_checks.value_scope: Published other mesenchymal-tumor regional methylation/expression and culture context undermine a generic new MEG3/imprinting story. Cultured GCT/MSC observations cannot act as native EMC replication or controls; no source numerical methylation/expression outcomes reanalysed.

preselected_region_and_quality.null_meaning: No whole region authenticated in this bounded source stage. Undefined coverage, not zero whole-locus probes or a measured methylation negative.
preselected_region_and_quality.prospective_order: Owner PLAN explicitly acknowledges previously visible exact-envelope/nearby EPIC facts, avoiding a false probe-blinded history. REGION-FROZEN occurs before fresh overlay, with no move/extension to known hits. A future candidate must be selected from independent source function/context and exact sequence/assembly scope before observing fresh coverage or beta values.
preselected_region_and_quality.quality_gate: A physically placed CpG/CGI, local converted-primer match or mapQ alone does not qualify a functional methylation assay. Authenticate CpG context and orientation, genome-wide bisulfite/probe specificity, source-version coherent ordering, recommended mapping/common-SNP/cross-reactivity masks and shared450K/EPIC representation. Previously observed nearby EPIC mapQ15/11 probes remain unqualified/pending, not automatic positive or global absence evidence.
preselected_region_and_quality.finite_reopening_contract: Freeze a justified regional coherence threshold before overlay, for example at least3 distinct qualified shared CpGs plus representation of each source-defined functional element rather than one neighboring proxy. This is a prospective methodological suggestion, not a validated biological cutoff or a reason to redefine the region. A small complete element could require its own source-justified assay contract. Retain element-specific results if source defines disjoint elements; never silently include intervening DNA.

native_coverage_and_independence.checked: All15 owner exports/78435bytes and5 retained source bindings match; all648 source metadata fields across10 native EMC and62 fixed potential primary-FFPE controls match prior inventory. native_coverage_and_independence.pending_sources: All ten whole-region statuses remain pending; fixed controls are an inventory, not numerical evaluation or guaranteed comparable strata. Source-reclassified SEF not EMC; generic/new classifier and nanopore/source-roster identities and direct regional measurements remain pending at owner/diagnostic scope. Classifier scores do not supply regional methylation. This review is not a new complete public-EMC census.

validity_and_value.validity: No unsupported whole interval or accepted probe set entered the gate, and no numerical result exists to interpret. Limited primary-definition and route-specific access observations reproduce. No whole-IG impossibility, allele-specific imprinting state, transcription, miRNA output or causal regulator claim is warranted.
validity_and_value.possible_value: A genuinely new replicated native pattern distinguishing primary-control-region from secondary-promoter measurements could influence which matched direct allele/RNA assay to undertake. That usefulness is conditional; bulk regional means alone do not determine the regulatory mechanism or appropriate treatment.
validity_and_value.strongest_alternative: The proposed regional difference can repeat lineage/classifier methylome or stromal/allelic mixture and source/chip history. A mean beta cannot identify parental allele, phase, tumor-cell origin or causal ordering. Source blood/culture patterns and normative thresholds cannot resolve these alternatives in native EMC.
validity_and_value.disproof_and_controls: Before future values freeze one joint primary-versus-secondary regional statistic and all fixed MLS/SS/LGFMS/SEF strata/available source-matched controls, shared probe quality, technical missingness and donor independence. Require coherent within-region CpGs, leave-one-donor and non-dominant-chip/purity/source/lineage sensitivities and truly independent native replication. A contrast already explained by published MEG3/imprinting facts, generic class separation, one chip or selected Case21 lacks standalone value even if technically correct. Suitable accessible pending EMC conditions block promotion.
validity_and_value.go_no_go: NO-GO current overlay/beta stage because primary whole definition is unresolved, before any quality or phenotype test. Not a claim that regional methylation is negative or that no future source/assay can answer the question.

review_limits: One bounded physical-region/assay/value batch. No unchanged exact-envelope rerun, genome-wide mapping, SNP-mask download, fresh whole-region probe count, beta/EMC phenotype inspection, full source-mechanism review or campaign-wide exhaustion. An initial broad text screen surfaced one routine non-methylation genetic-assay paragraph; it was excluded from retained extracts and no genomic-mechanism calculation/interpretation used it. The reproducible script selects only explicit methylation sections.
stop_and_reopen: Stop this review. Preserve original and later freezes. Reopen only with a source-authenticated complete human functional definition/element set and exact assembly or stable sequence identity, prospective coherent qualified coverage, complete relevant native condition/overlap controls and a fresh worthwhile measurement question. No manuscript or larger numerical stage authorized by this receipt.
